retrievalProfile.description: A moody, low-key photographic composition featuring a subject partially obscured by deep shadows and framed by architectural elements, paired with ultra-wide tracked sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, atmospheric scene where a female figure is positioned in a doorway on the left, casting long shadows into a predominantly black, textured void on the right. The composition is anchored by extreme horizontal typography at the top and bottom edges.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by vertical doorway on the far left
Large expanse of negative space/shadow occupying the right two-thirds
Symmetrical typographic headers at the extreme top and bottom margins
High contrast between the lit doorway and the surrounding darkness
coreInvariants: Vertical architectural framing of the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is small-to-medium scale, confined to the left vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright vertical sliver of the doorway on the left acts as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the lit figure on the left, move across the dark texture of the center, and are contained by the horizontal text lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant; approximately 70% of the frame is deep shadow or dark texture.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, extreme value contrast between highlights and shadows.

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlays dark areas for maximum legibility

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both top and bottom text to maintain symmetry.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along the frame edges

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the square, extended 80s geometric feel.
Provides the necessary horizontal weight and clean lines.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-key photograph of a person standing in a brightly lit doorway on the far left of a dark room. The rest of the frame should be filled with deep shadows and subtle dark textures. The lighting should be cinematic and noir-inspired.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase geometric sans-serif text at the very top and very bottom edges. Use extreme tracking so the text spans nearly the entire width of the frame. The text should be light grey or white.

verificationChecks: Is the text tracking extremely wide?
Is the subject confined to the left third?
Is the majority of the image deep shadow?
Are the fonts clean, uppercase sans-serifs?

mustRedesign: Any logos or specific artist names
Specific facial features of the original subject

avoid: Illegible text due to low contrast

postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not touch the subject
Ensure the right side of the image remains dark and atmospheric
Verify that the top and bottom text lines are horizontally aligned
Confirm the tracking is consistent across both lines of text
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-key noir photography + Left-aligned subject + Extreme wide-tracked geometric sans-serif headers
